name: DuckDB Vectors MCP server
description: Serves hybrid semantic + exact-token search over a local DuckDB index as two read-only tools: search returns ranked chunks, report introspects the index. No external vector service, no network at query time. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Both tools only read the local index; report exposes the indexed source paths (not contents), so point the server at a database whose file list is safe to disclose to the agent.
